name: Maou
source:
A dangerous and elusive criminal manipulator who uses young people in his schemes. He has a connection to [url=/c325]Haru[/url] and becomes engaged with her in what he calls a "game". He is secretly associated with the powerful Sannou Corporation. His face is unknown.

[spoiler]His true identity is that of Samejima Kyouhei, Kyousuke's older brother.[/spoiler]
